name: WereRat 2x Scale Test
author: vkays
description: Test mod: tries the WereRat.MODEL.TXT 'Render Scaling' field (a sidecar metadata value already used by the game -- base WereRat=1, Alpha=1.15, PRIME boss=1.5, tracking their actual in-game size tiers) as a whole-model scale mechanism, set here to 2, with a completely unmodified/unpatched .gr2. If the engine honors it, this makes every earlier .gr2-internal patching approach unnecessary for uniform scaling.
